main_block: Superset 1: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-065 | Leg Press] 4 sets of 10 reps, moderate to challenging weight
Exercise B: [IMF-098 | Seated Leg Curl] 4 sets of 12 reps, controlled tempo
Rest: 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
Superset 2: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-063 | Goblet Squat] 3 sets of 12 reps, focus on depth and upright torso
Exercise B: [IMF-114 | Hip Abduction Machine] 3 sets of 15 reps, controlled squeeze at the top
Rest: 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
Superset 3: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-082 | Leg Extension] 3 sets of 12 reps, full extension and slow return
Exercise B: [IMF-090 | Glute Bridge] 3 sets of 15 reps, strong hold at the top for one second
Rest: 60 seconds after completing both exercises, then repeat
[IMF-118 | Standing Calf Raise] 3 sets of 15 reps, rest 45 seconds between sets
